query:
with qualified as ( 
                 select d.player_id, count(*)::bigint as matches, 
                        sum(d.delta) as match_delta 
                 from player_match_rating_deltas d 
                 group by d.player_id having count(*) >= $1 
             ), adjusted as ( 
                 select a.player_id, sum(a.delta_mu) as adjust_delta 
                 from season_rating_adjustments a group by a.player_id 
             ) 
             select q.player_id as "player_id!", q.matches as "matches!", 
                    $2::double precision + coalesce(adj.adjust_delta, 0::double precision) 
                        + coalesce(q.match_delta, 0::double precision) as "rating!", 
                    p.trainer_name, 
                    (select s.display_name from player_discord_snapshots s 
                     where s.player_id = q.player_id order by s.id desc limit 1) as display_name 
             from qualified q 
             join players p on p.id = q.player_id 
             left join adjusted adj on adj.player_id = q.player_id 
             order by 3 desc, q.player_id 
             limit $3 offset $4
